videos.label: the same story, plus setup and the edge case
videos.title: ACME INVOICE BOT: HOW-TO

scenes.name: Intro
scenes.voiceover: Here's how to send invoices from a chat thread with Acme.

scenes.name: Install the bot
scenes.voiceover: First, install the bot from the app directory and add it to your channel.

shots.screen: App directory: search Acme, Install, pick the channel

scenes.name: Add the key
scenes.voiceover: Then paste your Acme Billing key into the bot's settings. It stays blurred, and it never lands in the chat.

shots.screen: Bot settings: paste the billing key (blurred), Save

scenes.name: Ask in the thread
scenes.voiceover: Now use it. In the thread where the deal was agreed, ask the bot to send an invoice. It drafts it first, so nothing is created until you say so.

scenes.name: Approve and check
scenes.voiceover: Press Approve. The invoice is created with a payment link, and it's right there in Acme Billing.

scenes.name: When the amount is missing
scenes.voiceover: If the thread has no amount, the bot asks one question instead of guessing.

shots.screen: No amount in the thread: the bot asks how much; Riley replies twelve hundred dollars

scenes.name: Close
scenes.voiceover: That's the Acme Invoice Bot. Invoices from the thread.

brief.summary: Two videos from one shoot. Riley (sales) asks the bot for an invoice in the thread where the deal was agreed; it drafts, Riley approves, and the invoice shows in Acme Billing.
